mapper.insert: insert into student( student_no, account_no, consult_customer_no, student_school, student_grade, student_gender, student_etc ) values( #{studentNo}, #{accountNo}, #{consultCustomerNo}, #{studentSchool}, #{studentGrade}, #{studentGender}, #{studentEtc} )
mapper.update: update student set student_school = #{studentSchool}, student_grade = #{studentGrade}, student_utime = systimestamp where account_no = #{accountNo}
mapper.select:
select S.student_no as studentNo, A.account_name as studentName, S.student_school as studentSchool, S.student_grade as studentGrade, S.student_academic_status as studentAcademicStatus,
-- 해당 학생의 누적 미납액 계산 NVL(( select sum(P.payment_amount - NVL( (select sum(H.payment_history_amount) from payment_history H where H.payment_no = P.payment_no) , 0)) from payment P where P.student_no = S.student_no and P.payment_status != '완납' ), 0) as totalUnpaidAmount,
100 as attendanceRate, 0 as unpaidAmount, '안전' as riskLevel from student S inner join account A on S.account_no = A.account_no
and exists ( select 1 from payment P where P.student_no = S.student_no and P.payment_status != '완납' )
and S.student_academic_status = '대기'
and S.student_academic_status in ('휴원', '퇴원')
and ( A.account_name like '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' or S.student_school like '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' )
order by S.student_no desc

select S.student_no as studentNo, S.account_no as accountNo, A.account_name as studentName, A.account_phone as studentPhone, A.account_id as studentEmail, S.student_school as studentSchool, S.student_grade as studentGrade, S.student_gender as studentGender, S.student_etc as studentEtc, S.student_academic_status as studentAcademicStatus,
-- DB에 아직 없는 테이블의 정보는 임시 가짜 데이터로 채웁니다. '김보호' as guardianName, '010-9999-8888' as guardianPhone, 'parent@test.com' as guardianEmail, '서울시 마포구 백범로 23' as address, 350000 as tuition, 1 as isPaid from student S inner join account A on S.account_no = A.account_no where S.student_no = #{studentNo}
mapper.update: update account set account_phone = #{studentPhone}, account_name = #{studentName}, account_utime = systimestamp where account_no = #{accountNo}

update student set student_school = #{studentSchool}, student_grade = #{studentGrade}, student_gender = #{studentGender}, student_etc = #{studentEtc}, student_utime = systimestamp where student_no = #{studentNo}
